name: Stoneweg Europe Stapled Trust
summary: Stoneweg Europe Stapled Trust (SERT) is a stapled group comprising Stoneweg European Real Estate Investment Trust and Stoneweg European Business Trust. SERT is a growth-ready European logistics and data center platform with resilient income and a clear path to long-term value creation, backed by a well-aligned sponsor ecosystem. SERT aims to provide sustainable distributions through active asset management and a disciplined approach to portfolio construction. SERT has a principal mandate to invest, directly or indirectly, in income-producing commercial real estate assets across Europe.
